sentences.en: She didn't come here to defend herself against these accusations.
sentences.zh: 她来这里并不是为了为自己辩护，对抗这些指控。

sentences.en: He denies this accusation and speaks only of a kiss.
sentences.zh: 他否认这一指控，并只谈到一个吻。

sentences.en: Dan didn't even have the courage to deny the accusations.
sentences.zh: 丹甚至没有勇气否认那些指控。

senses.zh: 控告，指责，谴责；（尚未证实的被控告的）罪名，罪状
